answer_4.quote: To obtain a baseline for human EI, we recruited participants through online surveys to complete our EI test.
answer_4.guideline: You will be asked to identify the emotions of the individual and their causes in this scenario. Your task is to : (1) Carefully read the design section and familiarize yourself with the emotion category. (2) Take the perspective of the people involved (think how you would feel in this situation). (3) Choose the appropriate answer from the given choices and enter in the provided Excel sheet.
